verdict.rationale: An AI-use disclosure is a fair question for an immigration legal-services provider, so the axis applies. None of Deel's pages in the evidence say whether or how AI is used in petition drafting or review. Mentions of dedicated attorneys, in-house experts filing forms, a fully digital platform and automated renewal reminders describe human staffing and workflow tooling, not a statement of what AI automates versus what attorneys check.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the provider states how it uses AI in petition drafting and review — what is automated, what a human attorney checks — on its own pages
